description: Make looping animated GIFs from a prompt, assembled locally. No server required.

defaultPrompt: Make a robot spin its head very fast while doing dramatic hand poses
Make a grumpy toaster shake angrily before launching two slices of toast into the air
Make a cat DJ scratch records aggressively while bobbing its head to a heavy beat
interface.longDescription: Describe any idea or send any photo and GifGen makes an animated GIF out of it: one sprite sheet of frames from image generation, sliced and encoded into a real looping GIF you can download

name: gifgen-local
